about: Desktop plugins the Athena build loads from $HERMES_HOME/desktop-plugins while managed.tools is enforce or report (slice 29). Each entry is the plugin id its default export declares and the sha256 of its plugin.js. Regenerate with `node apps/desktop/src/athena/scripts/desktop-plugin-hash.mjs --write` (builds athena's client/desktop-plugins/athena in a temporary copy); `--check` fails when this file is stale.
